prompt:
Our HR department needs a complete travel itinerary document for employee Zhang Wei's upcoming Japan trip. He is departing from Beijing on May 10, 2026, spending 2 nights in Tokyo and 2 nights in Osaka, then returning from Osaka on May 14, 2026. His interests include temples and shrines (including Kyoto), food markets in Osaka, and top sightseeing spots in Tokyo.

Please produce a complete, ready-to-submit itinerary file named **japan_itinerary_zhangwei.md**. The document must cover: visa requirements, outbound and return flights with clickable booking links, hotel recommendations for both cities with booking links, attraction suggestions with links, and a day-by-day schedule. HR will reject any document that does not include real-time pricing and actual booking links for every hotel, flight, and attraction listed.
